main_text.l: rare hominem:ubi uniuerfalem & propria
generationis hominis caufam ꝑfert[?], often
ditq; neutrā per fe quicquā gignere posse.
Nobis (forte) obiecerint Ferneliani, fed
perperā nō pauca animalia è putri materia,
absq; agente proprio, ut & plurimas plan-
tas sine semine, cuiusmodi sunt capillares
omnes,ui solis produci.Siquidem in mate-
ria putri, ex qua generantur imperfecta ani-
malia consistit proprium eorum generans,
quod quidē calore à sole facto uiuifico uti-
tur.Propterea ad generationem apum,quę
ex uituli cadauere oriuntur, sol cadaueris
calorem uiuificat,aptumq; reddit ad gene-
randas ipsas, apes è uituli conueniente ma-
teria.Tamersi uituli cadaueris calor est pu-
tridus ac alienus,tamen apibus gignendis
à sole fit idoneus.Etenim in natura nihil a-
lienum est.Idcirco calor ille, qui sub poten-
tia formæ cadaueris putrefacti consistit ad
generādum aptus est redditus. Solis enim
calor,licet corrumpat,& putrefaciat, uita-
lis tamē est,quia uitale est principiū.Quare
absq; eo nihil naturaliter gigni potest. Ve-
rumtamen per se nihil determinatum agit,
sicuti iam ostendimus, quoniam duntaxat
uniuersalis causa est. Si denique subiectis

page.notes: Passage is set in roman with long s printed as s throughout. Doubtful: the first letter of "ꝑfert" (printed as a p-like mark, possibly a sign for per) is marked [?]. "often" and "ditq;" are split across a line end with no hyphen and are copied as printed; "often" may be a broken form of "oftendit" but is transcribed as it stands. The word "ui" after "omnes," is copied as printed. Catchword "omnium" is set right below the last line.
